more_beautiful.reason: A is the more finished and cohesive page, with large, clear hierarchy, a consistent cream-and-cinnabar palette and even spacing; B has a lovely grid header, but its type is small and lightly weighted, its black button is stark, its desktop layout is lopsided with a large empty quadrant, and on mobile one line holds only 学员.

less_generic.reason: B's 米字格 practice-grid motif, used for the title and again as large 楷/行 character tiles on the class choices, is an idea that comes from calligraphy itself, while A is an ordinary rounded-card form dressed in the familiar seal, brush-title and red-swash 'Chinese style' formula.
